title: HugMesh worklist envelope (v1)
description: The frozen wire format for a mesh build worklist: an envelope around one base ImageConfig plus a list of per-image entries (one per role x platform). Emitted by the Studio (core/worklist.py WorklistConfig.to_dict) and the web admin-ui; validated by a Studio test AND the admin-bff bean validator (spec item 10). The `schema` key is the mandatory discriminator: ImageConfig.load rejects any JSON carrying it, and worklist.load_any routes it here. Anything WITHOUT a top-level `schema` key is a flat single-image ImageConfig and is NOT described by this schema.

schema.description: Version discriminator. MUST be present and exact for the envelope to be recognized.

entries.description: One entry per image the worklist builds (one per role x platform combo).

worklistEntry.description: A single image: a role x platform pair plus its per-image axes. `id` is the STABLE identity `f"{role}.{platform}"` used for domain attachment (Domain.images) and the derived per-image build_subdir `wl-<id>` (build_subdir is NOT stored on the wire).

id.description: Stable entry id `{role}.{platform}`. Derived from role/platform when omitted; honored verbatim on load for an exact round-trip.

encrypt_root.description: Per-image root-encryption override. `default` inherits the worklist-wide Home-page default; jetson rows are forced off in materialize regardless.

packages_add.description: Space-separated Portage atoms added to this image on top of the builder-derived default set. Each atom MUST match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9+._-]*/[A-Za-z0-9+._-]+$ (validate_package_atoms).

packages_drop.description: Space-separated Portage atoms removed from this image's default set (honoring the mandatory-payload floor). Same per-atom charset as packages_add.

imageConfig.description: A serialized ImageConfig (core/config.py ImageConfig.to_dict). The single-image plane — identity, network, domains, users, system, disk-encryption default. Only the load-bearing shared fields are pinned here; the full field set evolves with the dataclass, so unknown keys are tolerated (from_dict drops them). Plaintext SECRET_FIELDS (local_pass/luks_pass/user_password/root_password) are ALWAYS blanked on the wire.

superdomain.description: Orchestration superdomain all mesh nodes join; "" = derived <brand>.internal. NON_ARGV: manifest + KEYS channel, never a builder flag; permanently internal (I7).

domain.description: A cluster domain. `images` holds worklist entry-id refs this domain attaches to (empty = every eligible image). The legacy `games: bool` field was DROPPED — from_dict migrates a truthy value into optional_services += ["games"].
